prompt: Decompose the role 'barista' into a comprehensive flat list of discrete skills required for the job. All skills should have status 'stub' since they haven't been trained yet.

skills.name: Dialing In Espresso
skills.description: Adjust grind size, dose weight, and water yield to achieve target extraction time and flavor profile for specific coffee beans.

skills.name: Dosing and Puck Preparation
skills.description: Accurately weigh dry coffee grinds, distribute evenly across the portafilter basket (e.g., using WDT), and tamp level with consistent pressure.

skills.name: Espresso Shot Extraction
skills.description: Operate commercial espresso machine groups, monitor extraction flow, track yield and brew time, and identify signs of channeling or under/over-extraction.

skills.name: Milk Steaming and Microfoam Texturing
skills.description: Incorporate air and create uniform microfoam at proper temperatures for whole, skim, and non-dairy plant milks.

skills.name: Free-Pour Latte Art
skills.description: Pour textured milk into espresso to integrate crema and create standard visual patterns such as hearts, rosettas, and tulips.

skills.name: Standard Beverage Recipe Assembly
skills.description: Construct standard hot and iced espresso-based beverages (macchiatos, cortados, flat whites, cappuccinos, lattes, Americanos, mochas) to exact proportions.

skills.name: Batch Drip Brew Brewing
skills.description: Weigh, grind, and brew large-batch drip coffee according to brew ratios and cycle specifications, maintaining hot-holding urns.

skills.name: Manual Pour-Over Brewing
skills.description: Execute single-cup manual brews (e.g., V60, Chemex, Aeropress) controlling water temperature, blooming phase, and pulse pouring technique.

skills.name: Cold Brew Preparation and Dispensing
skills.description: Coarsely grind coffee, steep in immersion systems according to steep-time specifications, filter, dilute concentrate, and keg or dispense.

skills.name: Tea and Specialty Beverage Preparation
skills.description: Whisk matcha, steep loose-leaf and bag teas at correct water temperatures, prepare chai concentrates, and blend specialty cold drinks.

skills.name: Point-of-Sale (POS) and Cash Handling
skills.description: Accurately input customer orders, process cash and card payments, calculate change, apply modifications, and issue receipts.

skills.name: Customer Service and Line Management
skills.description: Greet patrons, answer menu and origin questions, manage expectations during rushes, and handle order inquiries or complaints courteously.

skills.name: Allergen Management and Cross-Contamination Prevention
skills.description: Isolate dairy and common allergens (tree nuts, soy, gluten) using dedicated steam pitchers, cloths, and sanitized preparation surfaces.

skills.name: Espresso Machine Maintenance and Backflushing
skills.description: Perform daily and mid-shift chemical backflushing of group heads, soak and scrub portafilter baskets, and clean dispersion screens.

skills.name: Steam Wand Purging and Sanitization
skills.description: Purge and wipe steam wands immediately before and after every use; perform daily soaking in milk line cleaner to remove buildup.

skills.name: Grinder Cleaning and Burr Maintenance
skills.description: Empty and clean bean hoppers, purge retained grounds, and brush or vacuum grinder burrs to prevent oil accumulation and rancidity.

skills.name: Bar Sanitation and Warewashing
skills.description: Sanitize countertops, rinse knockboxes and pitchers, operate commercial dishwashers, and keep 3-compartment sink sanitized per health code.

skills.name: Inventory Restocking and FIFO Rotation
skills.description: Restock beans, syrups, cups, lids, and milks according to First-In, First-Out (FIFO) standards and verify refrigerator holding temperatures.

skills.name: Food and Pastry Handling
skills.description: Handle, display, and heat food items and baked goods using tongs, parchment, or gloves in compliance with food safety regulations.

skills.name: Opening and Closing Checklists
skills.description: Execute open/close protocols including equipment warmup, cash drawer balancing, station breakdown, trash removal, and lockup.
